en: Hey, friends, ever wondered how one thought of inventing a machine that could see through
zh: 嘿，朋友們，有沒有想過是誰想到發明一台能透視的機器？
ja: ねえ、みんな、透視できる機械を発明しようと思ったのは誰か考えたことある？
local: Hey, friends, ever wondered how one thought of inventing a machine that could see through
ja_pron: Nee, minna, tōshi dekiru kikai o hatsumei shiyō to omotta no wa dare ka kangaeta koto aru?
native: Hey, friends, ever wondered how one thought of inventing a machine that could see through

en: the body, oh, I'm talking about the X-ray machine.
zh: 身體，哦，我說的是X光機。
ja: 体をね、ああ、X線装置のことを話しているんだ。
local: the body, oh, I'm talking about the X-ray machine.
ja_pron: Karada o ne, ā, X-sen sōchi no koto o hanashite iru nda.
native: the body, oh, I'm talking about the X-ray machine.

en: What an amazing invention, right?
zh: 多麼了不起的發明，對吧？
ja: なんて素晴らしい発明でしょう？
local: What an amazing invention, right?
ja_pron: Nante subarashii hatsumei deshō?
native: What an amazing invention, right?

en: Do you know the funny story behind it?
zh: 你知道它背後有趣的故事嗎？
ja: その裏にある面白い話を知ってる？
local: Do you know the funny story behind it?
ja_pron: Sono ura ni aru omoshiroi hanashi o shitteru?
native: Do you know the funny story behind it?

en: Zoom in!
zh: 放大鏡頭！
ja: ズームイン！
local: Zoom in!
ja_pron: Zūmu in!
native: Zoom in!

en: The invention of the X-ray was accidental.
zh: X光的發明是偶然的。
ja: X線の発明は偶然の産物でした。
local: The invention of the X-ray was accidental.
ja_pron: X-sen no hatsumei wa guuzen no sanbutsu deshita.
native: The invention of the X-ray was accidental.

en: Scientists in the 1800s were busy conducting experiments on the Gathod raid tube.
zh: 1800年代的科學家們忙著對陰極射線管進行實驗。
ja: 1800年代の科学者たちは陰極線管の実験に忙しかったのです。
local: Scientists in the 1800s were busy conducting experiments on the Gathod raid tube.
ja_pron: Sen happyaku nendai no kagakusha-tachi wa inkokusenkan no jikken ni isogashikatta no desu.
native: Scientists in the 1800s were busy conducting experiments on the Gathod raid tube.

en: Tough word, eh?
zh: 這詞很難懂，對吧？
ja: 難しい言葉だよね？
local: Tough word, eh?
ja_pron: Muzukashii kotoba da yo ne?
native: Tough word, eh?

en: But its function was quite simple, actually.
zh: 但它的功能其實很簡單。
ja: でも、その機能は実はとてもシンプルでした。
local: But its function was quite simple, actually.
ja_pron: Demo, sono kinō wa jitsu wa totemo shinpuru deshita.
native: But its function was quite simple, actually.

en: These are light emitting tubes that were earlier used in computers and TVs.
zh: 這些是早期用於電腦和電視的發光管。
ja: これらは以前コンピューターやテレビで使われていた発光管です。
local: These are light emitting tubes that were earlier used in computers and TVs.
ja_pron: Korera wa izen konpyūtā ya terebi de tsukawarete ita hakkōkan desu.
native: These are light emitting tubes that were earlier used in computers and TVs.

en: These tubes were quite unique, but no one could imagine that it would lead to such an
zh: 這些管子相當獨特，但沒有人能想像它會導致這樣的
ja: これらの管はかなり独特でしたが、それがこんなにも素晴らしい発明につながるとは誰も想像できませんでした。
local: These tubes were quite unique, but no one could imagine that it would lead to such an
ja_pron: Korera no kan wa kanari dokutoku deshita ga, sore ga konna ni mo subarashii hatsumei ni tsunagaru to wa dare mo sōzō dekimasen deshita.
native: These tubes were quite unique, but no one could imagine that it would lead to such an

en: amazing invention.
zh: 驚人的發明。
ja: 驚くべき発明でした。
local: amazing invention.
ja_pron: Odorokubeki hatsumei deshita.
native: amazing invention.

en: Back in 1895, it was yet another day at the lab for Willem Conrad Rongchen and his fellow
zh: 回到1895年，對威廉·康拉德·倫琴和他的同事們來說，這又是實驗室的普通一天。
ja: 1895年、ウィレム・コンラッド・レントゲンと彼の仲間たちにとっては、またいつもの研究室の日でした。
local: Back in 1895, it was yet another day at the lab for Willem Conrad Rongchen and his fellow
ja_pron: Sen happyaku kyūjū go nen, Uiremu Konraddo Rentogen to kare no nakama-tachi ni totte wa, mata itsumo no kenkyūshitsu no hi deshita.
native: Back in 1895, it was yet another day at the lab for Willem Conrad Rongchen and his fellow

en: workers.
zh: 工作人員。
ja: 作業員たちでした。
local: workers.
ja_pron: Sagyōin-tachi deshita.
native: workers.

en: While experimenting with glass Gathod raid tubes, Willem discovered that a piece of
zh: 在實驗玻璃陰極射線管時，威廉發現一塊
ja: ガラスの陰極線管を使った実験中に、ウィレムは一片の
local: While experimenting with glass Gathod raid tubes, Willem discovered that a piece of
ja_pron: Garasu no inkokusenkan o tsukatta jikken-chū ni, Uiremu wa ippen no
native: While experimenting with glass Gathod raid tubes, Willem discovered that a piece of

en: barium platinum cyanide, glowed even though the tube was encased in a thick black cardboard.
zh: 鋇鉑氰化物發光，儘管管子被厚厚的黑色紙板包覆著。
ja: バリウム白金シアン化物が光っていることを発見しました。管は厚い黒い段ボールで覆われていたのに。
local: barium platinum cyanide, glowed even though the tube was encased in a thick black cardboard.
ja_pron: Bariumu hakkin sian kabutsu ga hikatte iru koto o hakken shimashita. Kan wa atsui kuroi danbōru de ōwarete ita noni.
native: barium platinum cyanide, glowed even though the tube was encased in a thick black cardboard.

en: Hmm, his curiosity led him to find out the reason behind the strange phenomenon.
zh: 嗯，他的好奇心促使他找出這奇怪現象背後的原因。
ja: うーん、彼の好奇心がその奇妙な現象の理由を探らせました。
local: Hmm, his curiosity led him to find out the reason behind the strange phenomenon.
ja_pron: Ūn, kare no kōkishin ga sono kimyō na genshō no riyū o sagurasemashita.
native: Hmm, his curiosity led him to find out the reason behind the strange phenomenon.

en: After studies and experimentation, he came to a conclusion that some kind of radiation
zh: 經過研究和實驗，他得出結論，某種輻射
ja: 研究と実験の後、彼はある種の放射線が
local: After studies and experimentation, he came to a conclusion that some kind of radiation
ja_pron: Kenkyū to jikken no ato, kare wa aru shu no hōshasen ga
native: After studies and experimentation, he came to a conclusion that some kind of radiation

en: must be traveling in the space to make it happen.
zh: 一定是在空間中傳播，才會發生這種現象。
ja: この現象を引き起こすために空間を移動しているに違いないと結論づけました。
local: must be traveling in the space to make it happen.
ja_pron: Kono genshō o hikiokosu tame ni kūkan o idō shite iru ni chigainai to ketsuron dzukemashita.
native: must be traveling in the space to make it happen.

en: So he named it X-rays, taking X as an assumption for the unknown, little did he know
zh: 所以他將其命名為X射線，X代表未知，他卻不知道
ja: それで彼はそれをX線と名付けました。Xは未知のものの仮定として使われましたが、彼は知らなかったのです
local: So he named it X-rays, taking X as an assumption for the unknown, little did he know
ja_pron: Sore de kare wa sore o X-sen to nadzukemashita. X wa michi no mono no katei to shite tsukaware mashita ga, kare wa shiranakatta no desu
native: So he named it X-rays, taking X as an assumption for the unknown, little did he know

en: that he had changed the future completely.
zh: 他已經徹底改變了未來。
ja: 彼が未来を完全に変えてしまったことを。
local: that he had changed the future completely.
ja_pron: Kare ga mirai o kanzen ni kaete shimatta koto o.
native: that he had changed the future completely.

en: To test his newfound invention, Willem asked his wife for help.
zh: 為了測試他新發現的發明，威廉請他的妻子幫忙。
ja: 新たに発見した発明を試すために、ウィレムは妻に助けを求めました。
local: To test his newfound invention, Willem asked his wife for help.
ja_pron: Arata ni hakken shita hatsumei o tamesu tame ni, Uiremu wa tsuma ni tasuke o motomemashita.
native: To test his newfound invention, Willem asked his wife for help.

en: He captured images of the bones in her hand and her wedding ring, which became the first
zh: 他拍攝了她手骨和結婚戒指的影像，成為第一張
ja: 彼は彼女の手の骨と結婚指輪の画像を撮影し、それが最初の
local: He captured images of the bones in her hand and her wedding ring, which became the first
ja_pron: Kare wa kanojo no te no hone to kekkon yubiwa no gazō o satsuei shi, sore ga saisho no
native: He captured images of the bones in her hand and her wedding ring, which became the first

en: ever X-ray photo.
zh: X光照片。
ja: X線写真となりました。
local: ever X-ray photo.
ja_pron: X-sen shashin to narimashita.
native: ever X-ray photo.

en: He discovered that when emitted in complete darkness, X-rays passed through objects of varying
zh: 他發現當在完全黑暗中發射時，X光能穿透不同密度的物體，
ja: 完全な暗闇で放射されると、X線はさまざまな密度の物体を通り抜けることを発見しました。
local: He discovered that when emitted in complete darkness, X-rays passed through objects of varying
ja_pron: Kanzen na kurayami de hōsha sareru to, X-sen wa samazama na mitsudo no buttai o tōrinukeru koto o hakken shimashita.
native: He discovered that when emitted in complete darkness, X-rays passed through objects of varying

en: density, leaving the flesh and muscle of his wife's hand mostly transparent.
zh: 使他妻子手上的皮膚和肌肉大部分透明。
ja: 密度の違う物体を通り抜け、妻の手の肉や筋肉はほとんど透明に見えました。
local: density, leaving the flesh and muscle of his wife's hand mostly transparent.
ja_pron: Mitsudo no chigau buttai o tōrinuke, tsuma no te no niku ya kinniku wa hotondo tōmei ni miemashita.
native: density, leaving the flesh and muscle of his wife's hand mostly transparent.

en: The denser bones and the ring left behind a shadowed outline on a special photographic
zh: 較密集的骨頭和戒指在特殊的攝影板上留下了陰影輪廓，
ja: より密度の高い骨や指輪は、特殊な写真板に影の輪郭を残しました。
local: The denser bones and the ring left behind a shadowed outline on a special photographic
ja_pron: Yori mitsudo no takai hone ya yubiwa wa, tokushu na shashinban ni kage no rinkaku o nokoshimashita.
native: The denser bones and the ring left behind a shadowed outline on a special photographic

en: plate covered in barium platinum cyanide.
zh: 該攝影板覆蓋著鋇鉑氰化物。
ja: その写真板はバリウム白金シアン化物で覆われていました。
local: plate covered in barium platinum cyanide.
ja_pron: Sono shashinban wa bariumu hakkin sian kabutsu de ōwarete imashita.
native: plate covered in barium platinum cyanide.

en: The machine that he used for the experiment as the first Rongchenogram, Willem's discovery
zh: 他用於實驗的機器被稱為第一台倫琴攝影機，威廉的發現
ja: 彼が実験に使った機械は最初のレントゲノグラムと呼ばれ、ウィレムの発見は
local: The machine that he used for the experiment as the first Rongchenogram, Willem's discovery
ja_pron: Kare ga jikken ni tsukatta kikai wa saisho no Rentogenoguramu to yobare, Uiremu no hakken wa
native: The machine that he used for the experiment as the first Rongchenogram, Willem's discovery

en: garnered huge praise and attention in the field of science.
zh: 在科學領域獲得了極大的讚譽和關注。
ja: 科学の分野で大きな称賛と注目を集めました。
local: garnered huge praise and attention in the field of science.
ja_pron: Kagaku no bun'ya de ōkina shōsan to chūmoku o atsumemashita.
native: garnered huge praise and attention in the field of science.

en: His discovery became an instant favorite because no one had to cut through skin to examine
zh: 他的發現立刻成為熱門，因為沒有人需要切開皮膚來檢查
ja: 彼の発見はすぐに人気となりました。なぜなら、誰も皮膚を切開して調べる必要がなくなったからです。
local: His discovery became an instant favorite because no one had to cut through skin to examine
ja_pron: Kare no hakken wa sugu ni ninki to narimashita. Nazenara, dare mo hifu o sekkai shite shiraberu hitsuyō ga nakunatta kara desu.
native: His discovery became an instant favorite because no one had to cut through skin to examine

en: broken bones anymore.
zh: 骨折了。
ja: 骨折を調べるために切開する必要がなくなったのです。
local: broken bones anymore.
ja_pron: Kossetsu o shiraberu tame ni sekkai suru hitsuyō ga nakunatta no desu.
native: broken bones anymore.

en: He mentioned the pain he saved us from.
zh: 他提到他為我們減輕的痛苦。
ja: 彼は私たちが免れた痛みについて言及しました。
local: He mentioned the pain he saved us from.
ja_pron: Kare wa watashitachi ga manugareta itami ni tsuite genkyū shimashita.
native: He mentioned the pain he saved us from.

en: He gave his first public lecture on X-rays in January 1896 and showed the rays of ability
zh: 他於1896年1月首次公開演講X光，展示了X光能夠
ja: 彼は1896年1月に初めてX線についての公開講義を行い、その能力を示しました。
local: He gave his first public lecture on X-rays in January 1896 and showed the rays of ability
ja_pron: Kare wa 1896-nen 1-gatsu ni hajimete X-sen ni tsuite no kōkai kōgi o okonai, sono nōryoku o shimeshimashita.
native: He gave his first public lecture on X-rays in January 1896 and showed the rays of ability

en: to photograph the bones without the flesh.
zh: 能拍攝沒有肉的骨頭。
ja: 肉を通さずに骨を撮影することができることを。
local: to photograph the bones without the flesh.
ja_pron: Niku o tōsazu ni hone o satsuei suru koto ga dekiru koto o.
native: to photograph the bones without the flesh.

en: His fury spread like wildfire in the entire world.
zh: 他的發現像野火般迅速傳遍全世界。
ja: 彼の発見は世界中に瞬く間に広まりました。
local: His fury spread like wildfire in the entire world.
ja_pron: Kare no hakken wa sekaijū ni matatakuma ni hiromarimashita.
native: His fury spread like wildfire in the entire world.

en: In Canada, an X-ray was used to locate the exact place of a bullet in a patient's leg.
zh: 在加拿大，X光被用來定位病人腿上子彈的確切位置。
ja: カナダでは、X線が患者の脚にある弾丸の正確な位置を特定するために使われました。
local: In Canada, an X-ray was used to locate the exact place of a bullet in a patient's leg.
ja_pron: Kanada de wa, X-sen ga kanja no ashi ni aru dangan no seikaku na ichi o tokutei suru tame ni tsukawaremashita.
native: In Canada, an X-ray was used to locate the exact place of a bullet in a patient's leg.

en: Willem was awarded many a times, but he was the first to be awarded a Nobel Prize for
zh: 威廉多次獲獎，但他是第一個獲得諾貝爾物理學獎的人，
ja: ウィレムは何度も賞を受けましたが、1901年に物理学のノーベル賞を最初に受賞した人物です。
local: Willem was awarded many a times, but he was the first to be awarded a Nobel Prize for
ja_pron: Uiremu wa nando mo shō o ukemashita ga, 1901-nen ni butsuri-gaku no Nōberu-shō o saisho ni jushō shita jinbutsu desu.
native: Willem was awarded many a times, but he was the first to be awarded a Nobel Prize for

en: Physics in 1901.
zh: 1901年的諾貝爾物理學獎。
ja: 1901年の物理学賞です。
local: Physics in 1901.
ja_pron: 1901-nen no butsuri-gaku shō desu.
native: Physics in 1901.

en: Willem was also a very humble and a moralistic human being.
zh: 威廉也是一個非常謙虛且有道德的人。
ja: ウィレムは非常に謙虚で道徳的な人間でもありました。
local: Willem was also a very humble and a moralistic human being.
ja_pron: Uiremu wa hijō ni kenkyo de dōtokuteki na ningen demo arimashita.
native: Willem was also a very humble and a moralistic human being.

en: He didn't patent his discovery because he felt that it would stop scientific advances.
zh: 他沒有為他的發現申請專利，因為他認為這會阻礙科學進步。
ja: 彼は自分の発見に特許を取らなかったのは、それが科学の進歩を妨げると感じたからです。
local: He didn't patent his discovery because he felt that it would stop scientific advances.
ja_pron: Kare wa jibun no hakken ni tokkyō o toranakatta no wa, sore ga kagaku no shinpo o samatageru to kanjita kara desu.
native: He didn't patent his discovery because he felt that it would stop scientific advances.

en: Not just this, he also believed that science should not be for profit.
zh: 不僅如此，他還相信科學不應該為了利益。
ja: それだけでなく、彼は科学は利益のためであってはならないとも信じていました。
local: Not just this, he also believed that science should not be for profit.
ja_pron: Sore dake de naku, kare wa kagaku wa rieki no tame de atte wa naranai to mo shinjite imashita.
native: Not just this, he also believed that science should not be for profit.

en: You see kids, life of doctors became very easy after this invention.
zh: 孩子們，你們看，這項發明讓醫生的工作變得非常輕鬆。
ja: みんな、見てごらん、この発明のおかげで医者の生活がとても楽になったんだよ。
local: You see kids, life of doctors became very easy after this invention.
ja_pron: Minna, mite goran, kono hatsumei no okage de isha no seikatsu ga totemo raku ni natta nda yo.
native: You see kids, life of doctors became very easy after this invention.

en: Well, not only doctors, it made life easier for many people.
zh: 嗯，不只是醫生，這也讓許多人的生活更輕鬆。
ja: そうだね、医者だけでなく、多くの人々の生活も楽になったんだ。
local: Well, not only doctors, it made life easier for many people.
ja_pron: Sō da ne, isha dake de naku, ōku no hitobito no seikatsu mo raku ni natta nda.
native: Well, not only doctors, it made life easier for many people.

en: This brings us to...
zh: 這讓我們來到...
ja: これが私たちを導きます...
local: This brings us to...
ja_pron: Kore ga watashitachi o michibikimasu...
native: This brings us to...

en: Triv your time!
zh: 你的測驗時間！
ja: クイズの時間だよ！
local: Triv your time!
ja_pron: Kuizu no jikan da yo!
native: Triv your time!

en: X-rays helped art historians to examine paintings.
zh: X光幫助藝術史學家檢查畫作。
ja: X線は美術史家が絵画を調べるのに役立ちました。
local: X-rays helped art historians to examine paintings.
ja_pron: X-sen wa bijutsu shika ga kaiga o shiraberu no ni yakudachimashita.
native: X-rays helped art historians to examine paintings.

en: They could now see under paintings that are rough sketches, painters once used to guide
zh: 他們現在可以看到畫作底下的草圖，畫家曾用來指導
ja: 彼らは今、絵画の下にあるラフスケッチを見ることができ、画家がかつて作品を導くために使っていたものです。
local: They could now see under paintings that are rough sketches, painters once used to guide
ja_pron: Karera wa ima, kaiga no shita ni aru rafusuketchi o miru koto ga deki, gaka ga katsute sakuhin o michibiku tame ni tsukatte ita mono desu.
native: They could now see under paintings that are rough sketches, painters once used to guide

en: their work among other secrets.
zh: 他們的作品和其他秘密。
ja: 彼らの作品やその他の秘密を知ることができます。
local: their work among other secrets.
ja_pron: Karera no sakuhin ya sonohoka no himitsu o shiru koto ga dekimasu.
native: their work among other secrets.

en: Among these under paintings, helped art historians gain a better understanding of the
zh: 這些底層畫作幫助藝術史學家更好地理解
ja: これらの下絵の中で、美術史家はより良い理解を得ることができました。
local: Among these under paintings, helped art historians gain a better understanding of the
ja_pron: Korera no shitae no naka de, bijutsu shika wa yori yoi rikai o eru koto ga dekimashita.
native: Among these under paintings, helped art historians gain a better understanding of the

en: way artists once worked.
zh: 藝術家曾經工作的方式。
ja: かつて芸術家がどのように仕事をしていたかを。
local: way artists once worked.
ja_pron: Katsute geijutsuka ga dono yō ni shigoto o shite ita ka o.
native: way artists once worked.

en: It also helped them examine rare pieces of history, like the junction mummies and fossils
zh: 它還幫助他們檢查罕見的歷史文物，如交界木乃伊和化石，
ja: また、接合ミイラや化石のような珍しい歴史的遺物の調査にも役立ちました。
local: It also helped them examine rare pieces of history, like the junction mummies and fossils
ja_pron: Mata, setsugō miira ya kaseki no yō na mezurashii rekishiteki ibutsu no chōsa ni mo yakudachimashita.
native: It also helped them examine rare pieces of history, like the junction mummies and fossils

en: of ancient animals.
zh: 古代動物的化石。
ja: 古代動物の化石です。
local: of ancient animals.
ja_pron: Kodai dōbutsu no kaseki desu.
native: of ancient animals.

en: Not just history of broken bones, X-rays are also used to treat deadly diseases like
zh: 不僅是骨折的歷史，X光也用於治療致命疾病，如
ja: 骨折の歴史だけでなく、X線は癌や白血病のような致命的な病気の治療にも使われています。
local: Not just history of broken bones, X-rays are also used to treat deadly diseases like
ja_pron: Kossetsu no rekishi dake de naku, X-sen wa gan ya hakketsubyō no yō na chimeiteki na byōki no chiryō ni mo tsukawarete imasu.
native: Not just history of broken bones, X-rays are also used to treat deadly diseases like

en: cancer and cubicle losses.
zh: 癌症和白血病。
ja: 癌や白血病です。
local: cancer and cubicle losses.
ja_pron: Gan ya hakketsubyō desu.
native: cancer and cubicle losses.

en: So kids, don't sweat going to the doctor anymore if you hurt yourself while playing.
zh: 所以孩子們，如果你們玩耍時受傷了，不用擔心去看醫生。
ja: だから子供たち、遊んでいて怪我をしてももうお医者さんに行くのを怖がらなくていいよ。
local: So kids, don't sweat going to the doctor anymore if you hurt yourself while playing.
ja_pron: Dakara kodomotachi, asonde ite kega o shite mo mō oishasan ni iku no o kowagaranakute ii yo.
native: So kids, don't sweat going to the doctor anymore if you hurt yourself while playing.

en: I'll be back soon with an exciting story.
zh: 我很快會帶著一個精彩的故事回來。
ja: すぐにまた面白い話を持って戻ってくるよ。
local: I'll be back soon with an exciting story.
ja_pron: Sugu ni mata omoshiroi hanashi o motte modotte kuru yo.
native: I'll be back soon with an exciting story.

en: This is me Zooming Out!
zh: 這是我拉遠鏡頭！
ja: これでズームアウトします！
local: This is me Zooming Out!
ja_pron: Kore de zūmu auto shimasu!
native: This is me Zooming Out!

en: Hey kids, you liked my videos didn't you?
zh: 嘿孩子們，你們喜歡我的影片吧？
ja: ねえ子供たち、僕の動画気に入ったでしょ？
local: Hey kids, you liked my videos didn't you?
ja_pron: Nee kodomotachi, boku no dōga kiniitta desho?
native: Hey kids, you liked my videos didn't you?

en: Before you go, don't forget to click on the subscribe button and the bell.
zh: 在你離開之前，別忘了點擊訂閱按鈕和小鈴鐺。
ja: 行く前に、チャンネル登録ボタンとベルをクリックするのを忘れないでね。
local: Before you go, don't forget to click on the subscribe button and the bell.
ja_pron: Iku mae ni, chan'neru tōroku botan to beru o kurikku suru no o wasurenaide ne.
native: Before you go, don't forget to click on the subscribe button and the bell.

en: So you won't miss out on my latest videos!
zh: 這樣你就不會錯過我的最新影片！
ja: そうすれば僕の最新動画を見逃さないよ！
local: So you won't miss out on my latest videos!
ja_pron: Sō sureba boku no saishin dōga o minogasanai yo!
native: So you won't miss out on my latest videos!

en: See ya!
zh: 再見！
ja: またね！
local: See ya!
ja_pron: Mata ne!
native: See ya!
